title: 5-rad: CT radiomics of the future pancreatic remnant and CR-POPF after distal pancreatectomy
description: Code, de-identified data and results of the single-center study "Preoperative Prediction of Postoperative Pancreatic Fistula After Distal Pancreatectomy Using a Sparse Radiomic Signature of the Pancreatic Remnant" (Beaujon Hospital, AP-HP, Clichy, France). In 251 patients who underwent distal pancreatectomy in 2019-2025 (50 clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistulas, ISGPS grade B or C), radiomic features of the future pancreatic remnant (head-isthmus region) on preoperative portal venous CT were harmonized with ComBat, prefiltered without the outcome and selected with Stabl; an elastic-net logistic regression on five features (5-rad) was validated internally by bootstrap .632+ and strict nested cross-validation, compared with the D-FRS and DISPAIR-FRS, and used to define rule-out and rule-in risk groups. run_all.sh, or the Docker image, regenerates Tables 1-2, Supplementary Tables 1 and 4, Figures 1 and 3-5 and Supplementary Figures 1-3 from the de-identified radiomic-feature and clinical tables in data/. CT images and segmentation masks are not included.
